__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: Select the existing Flux-enabled InfluxDB datasource

title: TREVCAN Systems (draft)
description: First-pass read-only trend panels for the current Explorer domains. Not yet a functional replacement for all React dashboards.

panels.title: BMS cell voltages
panels.description: Requires BMS frames and an enabled BMS DBC.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal =~ /^CellVoltage_/)

panels.title: BMS temperatures
panels.description: Requires BMS frames and an enabled BMS DBC.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dbc == "BMS-Firmware-RTOS-Complete.dbc" and r.signal =~ /Temp|Therm/)

panels.title: HVC voltage and current
panels.description: Requires HVC frames and the HVC DBC.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dbc == "hvc.dbc" and r.signal =~ /Voltage|Current/)

panels.title: VCU values
panels.description: Provisional: VCU signal names and DBC selection must be reconciled with dual_bus.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal =~ /^VCU_/ and r.dbc == "master.dbc")

panels.title: MOBO voltage and current
panels.description: Requires MOBO frames and the MOBO DBC.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dbc == "Baby_MOBO.dbc" and r.signal =~ /Battery_Voltage|LV_Current|HC_Current/)

from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal =~ /^INV_.*(Temp|Temperature)/)

panels.title: Inverter speed, torque, and bus voltage
panels.description: Mixed units; split and set units before treating this as a final engineering display.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal == "INV_Motor_Speed" or r.signal == "INV_Torque_Feedback" or r.signal == "INV_DC_Bus_Voltage")
